subject: general
question: The tandem master cylinder is also known as _______________.
solution:
The correct answer is __a dual-line brake**(Option 1)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Tandem master cylinder__ is also referred to as a dual-line brake system.
 
• The system consists of two hydraulic circuits to operate the brakes.
 
• This design ensures safety and redundancy if one circuit fails.
 
• It is commonly used in modern vehicles to improve braking performance.
 
• The tandem master cylinder is a key component in hydraulic braking systems.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Single-line brake:**

 
 
• This system uses only one hydraulic circuit to operate brakes.
 
• It is less reliable compared to dual-line brake systems.
 
 
 
• **Electric brake:**
 
 
• Electric brakes use electromagnetic energy to slow down or stop vehicles.
 
• They are often found in trailer braking systems.
 
 
 
• **Manual brake:**
 
 
• Manual brakes are operated mechanically without hydraulic or electronic assistance.
 
• They are commonly found in older vehicles or as parking brakes.
